decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

decisions.choice: a wisdom psalm
decisions.reason: Psalm 49 is a teaching poem, like Proverbs and Job: it takes up the riddle of why the wicked rich prosper, and answers it with death, which no money can buy off, and with God, who ransoms the upright (verse 16). Psalm 73 asks the same question.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: as the titles of Psalms 42 and 47
decisions.reason: The Korah title is as in 42:1, and mizmor is भजन (L, B), गीत (R), as in 47:1.

decisions.choice: "Руководителю хора"; "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R); "Псалом" (L, B), "Песнь" (R)
decisions.reason: The title words have one form through the Korah psalms (42-49) as the poetry note gives them: "Руководителю хора" (L, B), "Для руководителя музыкантов" (R); "маскиль" kept as a term at Literal and Balanced, "песня, чтобы учить" at Readable; and "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R), with Korah in the form of Numbers 16 (Корей). This title uses them as in 42:1 and 47:1.

decisions.choice: children of humankind and children of man: people of low and high rank
alternatives: all people, every one of them
decisions.reason: The two phrases use two words for a human being ('adam and 'ish). Set side by side they seem to mean common people and people of rank, as in 62:10; the second half of the verse says the same with "rich and needy".

decisions.choice: children of humankind, children of people (L), with "sons of" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The phrases mean human beings of every kind (m1). Balanced says what they mean and needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: "enfants des humains" and "enfants de l'humain" at Literal, with "fils des hommes" and "fils de l'homme" as the alternatives
decisions.reason: The two phrases mean human beings of every rank (meaning decision m1). French puts the setting on the nouns, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say what the phrases mean and need no setting.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "wana wa Adamu" and "wana wa mtu" at Literal, and plain verb forms for "they" and "he" through this psalm
decisions.reason: Swahili "wana" (children) and "mtu" (person) already include women, and the verb prefix "a-" means "he" or "she" alike, so where the English Literal has gender spans in this psalm the Swahili has one wording and nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "con cái loài người", "con cái của người ta" with no gender spans, here and through the psalm
alternatives: spans with "con trai" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cái" and "người" already include men and women, and the traditional "sons of" has no separate Vietnamese wording a reader expects, so the English gender spans in this psalm have no Vietnamese counterpart (as Psalm 1:1).

decisions.choice: Literal has gender spans on both phrases, "자녀들" (children) by default with "아들들" (sons) as the alternative; elsewhere in the psalm "사람" (person) needs no span
decisions.reason: The English offers "sons of" as an alternative here, and Korean has both wordings. Where the English has "humankind|man" or "someone|a man" (verses 13, 17, 21), Korean "사람" and "누가" already mean anyone, so there is no second wording to offer (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: os filhos da humanidade, os filhos das pessoas; with "os filhos dos homens", "os filhos dos varões" as the alternatives
decisions.reason: As the English: the two phrases mean people of every rank (m1). The traditional alternative for the second keeps "varão", the old Portuguese word for a man that distinguishes the second Hebrew word from the first.

decisions.choice: "የሰው ዘሮች", "የሰው ልጆች" (for 'adam and 'ish), and the generic singular later in the psalm, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The English offers an inclusive and a traditional wording here. The Amharic word (ሰው, የሰው ልጆች, or the generic singular suffix) already speaks of men and women alike, so there is no second wording to offer and no span (docs/amharic-style.md 7b). This holds for the rest of the psalm.

decisions.choice: {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्र}}; {{gender:लोगों की सन्तान|पुरुषों के पुत्र}}
alternatives: मनुष्यों के पुत्र और पुरुषों के पुत्र
decisions.reason: As in the English, the two phrases mean human beings of every kind, low and high; the first has the form of Psalm 14:2 (मनुष्य की सन्तान), used for this phrase throughout Psalms 42-72 (Balanced and Readable say so and need no setting). Elsewhere in this psalm the English Literal has gender spans on pronouns and on "humankind" (verses 10, 13, 17-21); Hindi वह, उसका are not marked for sex and मनुष्य is any human being, so the Hindi has one wording there and a span only where it has two (verse 17, कोई व्यक्ति / कोई पुरुष).

decisions.choice: "дети людские", "дети человеческие", with "сыны" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The two phrases mean people of every rank (m1); as in the English, Literal keeps them with the traditional "сыны" as the alternative, and Balanced says what they mean.

decisions.choice: No gender span: benei adam / benei ish "人の子らも、人間の子らも" (L), "身分の低い者も高い者も" (B); 'evyon "乏しい者" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 and 子ら already include women (PSA-1), so the English gender spans of 49:3, 10, 13, 17-21 have no Japanese span; the pair is read as people of low and high rank (m1, uncertain).

sw.R: Nitawaambia mambo ya hekima. Nimeyafikiri sana, nami nayaelewa.

es.L: Mi boca hablará sabiduría, y la meditación de mi corazón [será] entendimiento.
es.B: Lo que diga será sabio; lo que mi corazón ha meditado dará entendimiento.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} voy a decir cosas sabias. He pensado mucho en ellas, y las entiendo.

vi.L: Miệng tôi sẽ nói sự khôn ngoan, và sự suy ngẫm của lòng tôi [sẽ là] sự hiểu biết.
vi.B: Điều tôi nói sẽ là lời khôn ngoan; điều lòng tôi suy ngẫm sẽ đem lại sự thông sáng.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ nói cho các bạn những điều khôn ngoan. Tôi đã suy nghĩ kỹ về những điều ấy, và tôi hiểu.

ko.L: 내 입이 지혜를 말할 것이요, 내 마음의 묵상은 명철[일 것이다].
ko.B: 내가 하는 말은 지혜로울 것이요, 내 마음이 깊이 생각한 것은 깨달음을 줄 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 지혜로운 것을 말해 주겠다. 내가 깊이 생각해 보았고, 이제 깨달았다.

pt.L: A minha boca falará sabedoria, e a meditação do meu coração [será] entendimento.
pt.B: O que eu disser será sábio; o que o meu coração meditou trará entendimento.
pt.R: Vou dizer a vocês coisas sábias. Pensei muito nelas e as entendo.

am.L: አፌ ጥበብን ይናገራል፤ የልቤም ማሰላሰል ማስተዋል [ይሆናል]።
am.B: የምናገረው ጥበብ ይሆናል፤ ልቤ ያሰላሰለውም ማስተዋልን ይሰጣል።
am.R: ጥበብ ያለበትን ነገር እነግራችኋለሁ። ስለ እርሱ በጥልቅ አስቤበታለሁ፤ አስተውዬዋለሁም።

hi.L: मेरा मुँह बुद्धि की बातें कहेगा, \q और मेरे मन का ध्यान समझ [की बातें होगा]।
hi.B: जो मैं कहूँगा वह बुद्धि की बात होगी; \q जिस पर मेरे मन ने विचार किया है, वह समझ देगा।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें बुद्धि की बातें बताऊँगा। \q मैंने उन पर बहुत सोचा है, और मैं उन्हें समझता हूँ।

ru.L: Уста мои будут говорить мудрость, \q и размышление сердца моего — разум.
ru.B: То, что я скажу, будет мудрым; \q в том, что обдумало моё сердце, будет разум.
ru.R: Я расскажу вам мудрые вещи. \q Я долго думал о них, и я понимаю.

ja.L: わたしの口は知恵を語り、 \q わたしの心の思いは悟り[となる]。
ja.B: わたしが語ることは知恵に満ち、 \q わたしの心が思い巡らしたことは悟りを与える。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちに賢いことを話そう。 \q わたしはそれをよく考えてきたので、よくわかっている。

uk.L: Мої уста говоритимуть мудрість, \q а роздум мого серця — розуміння.
uk.B: Те, що я скажу, буде мудре; \q те, що обдумало моє серце, дасть розуміння.
uk.R: Я скажу вам мудрі речі. \q Я добре над ними подумав, і я розумію.

decisions.choice: wisdom, understanding: plurals of fullness
decisions.reason: Both words are plural in form, meaning deep or complete wisdom and understanding.

decisions.choice: meditation: quiet, careful thought
decisions.reason: The word (hagut) is from the verb used in 1:2 for murmuring God's instruction to oneself: thought turned over and over.

decisions.choice: "мудрость"; "разум" (L, B), "понимаю" (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's words for hokmah and tevunah, the words of the wisdom books.

decisions.choice: hagut libbi "わたしの心の思い" (L), "わたしの心が思い巡らしたこと" (B)
decisions.reason: Quiet, careful thought (m2), from the same root as hagah in 1:2.

source.text: אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אָזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will incline to a proverb my ear; I will open with a lyre my riddle.

en.L: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my riddle with [the] lyre.
en.B: I will listen closely to a proverb; to the music of the lyre I will lay open my riddle.
en.R: I will listen carefully to a wise saying. Then I will play the harp and explain a hard question.

fr.L: Je tendrai l’oreille à un proverbe ; j’ouvrirai mon énigme sur la lyre.
fr.B: J’écouterai attentivement un proverbe ; au son de la lyre j’exposerai mon énigme.
fr.R: J’écouterai avec attention une parole de sagesse. Puis je jouerai de la harpe et j’expliquerai une question difficile.

sw.L: Nitatega sikio langu kwa mithali; nitafungua fumbo langu kwa kinubi.
sw.B: Nitasikiliza kwa makini mithali; kwa muziki wa kinubi nitalifumbua fumbo langu.
sw.R: Nitasikiliza kwa makini neno la hekima. Kisha nitapiga kinubi na kueleza swali gumu.

es.L: Inclinaré mi oído a un proverbio; abriré mi enigma con [la] lira.
es.B: Escucharé con atención un proverbio; al son de la lira expondré mi enigma.
es.R: Escucharé con atención un dicho sabio. Luego tocaré el arpa y explicaré una pregunta difícil.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ nghiêng tai nghe một câu châm ngôn; tôi sẽ mở câu đố của tôi bằng đàn lia.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ lắng tai nghe một câu châm ngôn; theo tiếng đàn lia, tôi sẽ giải bày câu đố của tôi.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ chăm chú nghe một câu nói khôn ngoan. Rồi tôi sẽ gảy đàn và giải thích một câu hỏi khó.

ko.L: 내가 잠언에 내 귀를 기울이고, 수금으로 내 수수께끼를 풀 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 잠언에 귀를 기울이고, 수금 소리에 맞추어 내 수수께끼를 풀어 보이겠다.
ko.R: 나는 지혜로운 말씀에 귀 기울이겠다. 그다음 수금을 타면서 어려운 문제를 풀어 주겠다.

pt.L: Inclinarei o meu ouvido a um provérbio; abrirei o meu enigma com [a] lira.
pt.B: Escutarei com atenção um provérbio; ao som da lira exporei o meu enigma.
pt.R: Vou escutar com atenção um ditado sábio. Depois vou tocar a harpa e explicar uma pergunta difícil.

am.L: ጆሮዬን ወደ ምሳሌ አዘነብላለሁ፤ እንቆቅልሼንም በበገና እገልጣለሁ።
am.B: ምሳሌን በጥንቃቄ አደምጣለሁ፤ በበገና ዜማም እንቆቅልሼን እገልጣለሁ።
am.R: ጥበብ ያለበትን አባባል በጥንቃቄ አደምጣለሁ። ከዚያም በገና እየደረደርኩ ከባድ ጥያቄን አብራራለሁ።

hi.L: मैं कहावत की ओर अपना कान लगाऊँगा; \q मैं वीणा [के साथ] अपनी पहेली खोलूँगा।
hi.B: मैं एक कहावत को ध्यान से सुनूँगा; \q वीणा के संगीत के साथ मैं अपनी पहेली खोलकर बताऊँगा।
hi.R: मैं बुद्धि की एक बात को ध्यान से सुनूँगा। \q फिर मैं वीणा बजाकर एक कठिन प्रश्न समझाऊँगा।

ru.L: Приклоню к притче ухо моё; \q открою на лире загадку мою.
ru.B: Я внимательно выслушаю притчу; \q под звуки лиры я раскрою свою загадку.
ru.R: Я внимательно выслушаю мудрое изречение. \q Потом я сыграю на арфе и объясню трудный вопрос.

ja.L: わたしは格言に耳を傾け、竪琴をもって、 \q わたしのなぞを解き明かそう。
ja.B: わたしは格言に耳を澄まし、 \q 竪琴の調べに合わせて、わたしのなぞを解き明かす。
ja.R: わたしは、知恵のある言葉に、よく耳を傾けよう。 \q それから、たて琴をひいて、難しい問いを説き明かそう。

uk.L: Я прихилю своє вухо до приповісті; \q я відкрию свою загадку на лірі.
uk.B: Я уважно слухатиму приповість; \q під звуки ліри я розкрию свою загадку.
uk.R: Я уважно слухатиму мудрий вислів. \q Потім я заграю на лірі й поясню важке питання.

decisions.choice: proverb: a wise saying
decisions.reason: The word (mashal) is a saying, a comparison or a parable; here probably the refrain of verses 13 and 21, which compares people to animals.

decisions.choice: riddle: a hard question
decisions.reason: The word (chidah) is a riddle or a puzzle (Judges 14:12). The puzzle is why the wicked rich do well, and whether the upright should fear them (verse 6).

decisions.choice: incline my ear: the teacher first listens
decisions.reason: The teacher listens for the wisdom he passes on, as a prophet hears before he speaks; to open a riddle is to set it out or explain it.

decisions.choice: lyre: a stringed instrument
decisions.reason: The kinnor was a small stringed instrument, played by hand, as David did (1 Samuel 16:23).

decisions.choice: "đàn lia" (L, B); "đàn" (R)
decisions.reason: The instrument is a small stringed lyre (see the meaning decision); "đàn hạc" names a larger harp. Readable just says "gảy đàn" (play a stringed instrument).

decisions.choice: mashal "格言" (L, B), "知恵のある言葉" (R); chidah "なぞ" (L, B), "難しい問い" (R)
decisions.reason: A wise saying (m1) and a hard question (m2), in the words of Proverbs.

source.text: לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Why should I fear in days of evil, [when the] iniquity of my heels surrounds me,

en.L: Why should I fear in days of evil, [when] the iniquity of my heels surrounds me,
en.B: Why should I be afraid in evil times, when the wrongdoing of those who dog my steps closes in on me,
en.R: Why should I be afraid when times are bad? Why should I be afraid when cheaters are all around me?

fr.L: Pourquoi craindrais-je aux jours de malheur, [quand] la faute de mes talons m’entoure,
fr.B: Pourquoi aurais-je peur aux jours mauvais, quand la malice de ceux qui me talonnent se resserre sur moi,
fr.R: Pourquoi aurais-je peur quand les temps sont durs ? Pourquoi aurais-je peur quand des tricheurs sont tout autour de moi ?

sw.L: Kwa nini niogope katika siku za uovu, [wakati] uovu wa visigino vyangu unanizunguka,
sw.B: Kwa nini niogope nyakati mbaya, wakati uovu wa wale wanaonifuata nyayo unanizingira,
sw.R: Kwa nini niogope nyakati zinapokuwa mbaya? Kwa nini niogope wadanganyifu wanaponizunguka?

es.L: ¿Por qué he de temer en los días malos, [cuando] la iniquidad de mis talones me rodea,
es.B: ¿Por qué he de tener miedo en tiempos malos, cuando me rodea la maldad de los que me siguen los pasos,
es.R: ¿Por qué voy a tener miedo cuando vienen tiempos malos? ¿Por qué voy a tener miedo cuando los tramposos me rodean?

vi.L: Tại sao tôi phải sợ trong những ngày gian ác, [khi] sự gian ác của những kẻ bám gót tôi vây quanh tôi,
vi.B: Tại sao tôi phải sợ trong thời buổi xấu xa, khi sự gian ác của những kẻ bám theo gót tôi bủa vây tôi,
vi.R: Tại sao tôi phải sợ khi thời buổi khó khăn? Tại sao tôi phải sợ khi những kẻ gian lận ở quanh tôi?

ko.L: 어찌하여 내가 악한 날들에 두려워하겠는가, 내 발꿈치의 죄악이 나를 에워쌀 [때에]?
ko.B: 악한 때에 내가 왜 두려워해야 하는가? 내 뒤를 쫓는 자들의 악이 나를 에워쌀 때에?
ko.R: 힘든 때가 왔다고 내가 왜 두려워해야 하는가? 남을 속이는 자들이 나를 둘러싸고 있다고 내가 왜 두려워해야 하는가?

pt.L: Por que temeria eu nos dias do mal, [quando] a iniquidade dos meus calcanhares me cerca,
pt.B: Por que eu teria medo nos tempos maus, quando a maldade dos que me seguem os passos me cerca,
pt.R: Por que eu teria medo quando os tempos são ruins? Por que teria medo quando há trapaceiros ao meu redor?

am.L: በክፉ ቀን ለምን እፈራለሁ፣ የተረከዞቼ በደል ሲከብበኝ፣
am.B: በክፉ ዘመን ለምን እፈራለሁ፣ ፈለጌን የሚከተሉ ሰዎች ክፋት በዙሪያዬ ሲከበኝ፣
am.R: ዘመኑ ክፉ ሲሆን ለምን እፈራለሁ? አታላዮች በዙሪያዬ ሲሆኑ ለምን እፈራለሁ?

hi.L: मैं बुराई के दिनों में क्यों डरूँ, \q [जब] मेरी एड़ियों का अधर्म मुझे घेर लेता है,
hi.B: मैं बुरे समय में क्यों डरूँ, \q जब मेरे पीछे पड़े लोगों की बुराई मुझे घेर लेती है,
hi.R: जब समय बुरा हो, तब मैं क्यों डरूँ? \q जब धोखेबाज़ मेरे चारों ओर हों, तब मैं क्यों डरूँ?

ru.L: Почему мне бояться в дни зла, \q [когда] беззаконие моих пят окружает меня,
ru.B: Почему мне бояться в злые времена, когда меня окружает неправда тех, \q кто идёт за мной по пятам,
ru.R: Почему я должен бояться, когда времена плохие? \q Почему я должен бояться, когда вокруг меня обманщики?

ja.L: 災いの日々に、なぜ、わたしが恐れなければならないのか？ \q わたしのかかとの咎が、わたしを取り囲むときに。
ja.B: 悪い時代に、なぜ、わたしが恐れることがあろうか？ \q わたしにつきまとう者たちの悪が、わたしを取り囲むとしても。
ja.R: 悪い時に、なぜ、わたしが恐れることがあろうか？ \q ずるい人たちに囲まれても、なぜ恐れることがあろうか？

uk.L: Чому я маю боятися в дні лиха, \q [коли] беззаконня моїх пʼят оточує мене,
uk.B: Чому я маю боятися в лихі часи, коли кривда тих, \q хто йде за мною по пʼятах, обступає мене,
uk.R: Чому я маю боятися, коли настають погані часи? \q Чому я маю боятися, коли довкола мене ошуканці?

decisions.choice: my heels: those at my heels, people who cheat me
alternatives: the wrong I have done at every step
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the iniquity of my heels". The word for heel ('aqev) is the root of the name Jacob, who grabbed his brother's heel and later cheated him (Genesis 27:36), so "my heels" may be those who follow at my heels to trip me up. With different vowels it reads "my deceivers". Verse 7 says who they are: the rich who trust in wealth.

decisions.choice: Why should I fear?: the riddle
decisions.reason: This is the question the psalm answers: there is no need to fear the powerful rich.

decisions.choice: cheaters
decisions.reason: Readable follows the likeliest sense (m1).

decisions.choice: "những kẻ bám gót tôi" for "my heels"
decisions.reason: "The iniquity of my heels" most likely means the wrong done by those at my heels (see the meaning decision); "gót chân tôi" alone would make no sense in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: The question mark at the end of 49:6 (L, B) rather than at the end of 49:7, where the English has it
decisions.reason: The English question runs to the end of 49:7 (m2); Japanese closes the question with its verb in 49:6, so 49:7 describes the people and needs no question mark.

decisions.choice: 'avon 'aqevai "わたしのかかとの咎" (L), "わたしにつきまとう者たちの悪" (B), "ずるい人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: Those at my heels, people who cheat me (m1, uncertain, footnoted).

source.text: הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל־חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: those who trust in their wealth, and in [the] abundance of their riches they boast?

en.L: those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the abundance of their riches?
en.B: people who rely on their money and brag about how rich they are?
en.R: They trust in their money and brag about how much they have.

fr.L: ceux qui se confient en leur fortune, et se vantent de l’abondance de leurs richesses ?
fr.B: ces gens qui comptent sur leur argent et se vantent de leurs grandes richesses ?
fr.R: Ils ont confiance en leur argent et se vantent d’en avoir beaucoup.

sw.L: wale wanaotumainia mali yao, na kujivuna kwa wingi wa utajiri wao?
sw.B: watu wanaotegemea fedha zao na kujigamba kwa jinsi walivyo matajiri?
sw.R: Wanategemea fedha zao na kujisifu kwa wingi wa mali walizo nazo.

es.L: los que confían en sus bienes, y se jactan de la abundancia de sus riquezas?
es.B: gente que confía en su dinero y presume de lo rica que es?
es.R: Ellos confían en su dinero y presumen de todo lo que tienen.

vi.L: những kẻ tin cậy nơi của cải mình, và khoe khoang về sự giàu có dư dật của mình?
vi.B: những kẻ dựa vào tiền bạc và khoe khoang mình giàu có biết bao?
vi.R: Chúng tin cậy vào tiền bạc và khoe khoang mình có nhiều của cải.

ko.L: 자기들의 재물을 의지하고, 자기들의 많은 부를 자랑하는 자들[을]?
ko.B: 자기 돈을 믿고, 자기가 얼마나 부자인지 자랑하는 자들을?
ko.R: 그들은 자기 돈을 믿고, 가진 것이 많다고 자랑한다.

pt.L: os que confiam na sua riqueza, e se gloriam na abundância das suas riquezas?
pt.B: pessoas que confiam no seu dinheiro e se gabam de quanto são ricas?
pt.R: Elas confiam no seu dinheiro e se gabam de quanto têm.

am.L: በሀብታቸው የሚታመኑ፣ በብልጽግናቸውም ብዛት የሚመኩ?
am.B: በገንዘባቸው የሚተማመኑና በሀብታቸው ብዛት የሚኩራሩ ሰዎች?
am.R: እነርሱ በገንዘባቸው ይታመናሉ፤ ባላቸውም ብዛት ይኩራራሉ።

hi.L: उनसे जो अपने धन पर भरोसा रखते हैं, \q और अपनी संपत्ति की बहुतायत पर घमंड करते हैं?
hi.B: उन लोगों से जो अपने पैसे पर निर्भर रहते हैं \q और इस पर डींग मारते हैं कि वे कितने धनी हैं?
hi.R: वे अपने पैसे पर भरोसा रखते हैं \q और डींग मारते हैं कि उनके पास कितना कुछ है।

ru.L: надеющихся на богатство своё \q и хвалящихся множеством своего богатства?
ru.B: людей, которые полагаются на свои деньги \q и хвастаются тем, как они богаты?
ru.R: Они надеются на свои деньги и хвастаются тем, \q сколько у них всего.

ja.L: 自分の財産に信頼し、 \q その富の豊かさを誇る者たちの[咎が]。
ja.B: 彼らは、自分の金に頼り、 \q どれほど豊かであるかを自慢する者たちだ。
ja.R: 彼らは、自分のお金に頼り、 \q どんなに多く持っているかを自慢する。

uk.L: тих, хто покладається на своє багатство \q й хвалиться великим своїм достатком?
uk.B: людей, які покладаються на свої гроші \q й вихваляються, які вони багаті?
uk.R: Вони довіряють своїм грошам \q і хваляться тим, скільки в них є.

decisions.choice: those who trust: the rich of verse 6
decisions.reason: The verse explains who surrounds him: people whose confidence is in their wealth.

decisions.choice: trust in wealth: the wrong refuge
decisions.reason: Trusting in riches is set against trusting in God (52:9; Proverbs 11:28).

decisions.choice: batach "信頼する" (L), "頼る" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Trust in wealth is the wrong refuge (m2); Balanced and Readable use the everyday "頼る" for trusting in money, keeping 信頼する for trust in God.

source.text: אָ֗ח לֹא־פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כָּפְרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: A brother, not he can at all ransom anyone; not he can give to God his ransom,

en.L: A brother — [one] cannot by any means ransom [him]; no one can give to God the ransom for [him],
en.B: No one can ever buy back the life of another, or pay God the price for that person's life,
en.R: No one can pay God enough to save someone else's life.

fr.L: Un frère — [on] ne peut en aucune façon [le] racheter ; nul ne peut donner à Dieu sa rançon,
fr.B: Personne ne pourra jamais racheter la vie d’un autre, ni payer à Dieu le prix de sa vie,
fr.R: Personne ne peut payer assez à Dieu pour sauver la vie de quelqu’un d’autre.

sw.L: Ndugu — [mtu] hawezi kwa vyovyote kumkomboa; hakuna awezaye kumpa Mungu fidia kwa ajili [yake],
sw.B: Hakuna mtu awezaye kamwe kukomboa maisha ya mwingine, wala kumlipa Mungu gharama ya maisha ya mtu huyo,
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kumlipa Mungu kiasi cha kutosha kuokoa maisha ya mtu mwingine.

es.L: Un hermano —de ningún modo puede [uno] rescatar[lo]; nadie puede dar a Dios el rescate por [él],
es.B: Nadie puede jamás rescatar la vida de otro, ni pagarle a Dios el precio por la vida de esa persona,
es.R: Nadie puede pagarle a Dios lo suficiente para salvar la vida de otra persona.

vi.L: Một người anh em — [không ai] có thể nào chuộc [người ấy]; không ai có thể dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời giá chuộc [người ấy],
vi.B: Không ai có thể chuộc mạng sống của người khác, hay trả cho Đức Chúa Trời giá chuộc mạng người ấy,
vi.R: Không ai có thể trả cho Đức Chúa Trời đủ giá để cứu mạng sống của người khác.

ko.L: 형제라도 — [아무도 그를] 결코 속량할 수 없고, 하나님께 [그를 위한] 몸값을 드릴 수 없다.
ko.B: 아무도 다른 사람의 생명을 값을 치르고 되찾을 수 없고, 그 생명의 값을 하나님께 치를 수 없다.
ko.R: 아무도 다른 사람의 목숨을 구하려고 하나님께 충분한 값을 치를 수 없다.

pt.L: Um irmão — [ninguém] pode de modo algum resgatá-[lo]; ninguém pode dar a Deus o resgate por [ele],
pt.B: Ninguém pode jamais resgatar a vida de outra pessoa, nem pagar a Deus o preço pela vida dela,
pt.R: Ninguém consegue pagar a Deus o bastante para salvar a vida de outra pessoa.

am.L: ወንድምን — ማንም ፈጽሞ ሊዋጅ አይችልም፤ ማንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤዛውን ሊሰጥ አይችልም፤
am.B: ማንም የሌላውን ሰው ሕይወት ፈጽሞ ሊዋጅ ወይም ለዚያ ሰው ሕይወት ዋጋውን ለእግዚአብሔር ሊከፍል አይችልም፤
am.R: የሌላውን ሰው ሕይወት ለማዳን በቂ ዋጋ ለእግዚአብሔር ሊከፍል የሚችል ማንም የለም።

hi.L: भाई — कोई [उसे] किसी रीति से छुड़ा नहीं सकता; \q कोई परमेश्वर को [उसके] लिए छुड़ौती नहीं दे सकता,
hi.B: कोई भी किसी दूसरे का प्राण कभी नहीं छुड़ा सकता, \q न उस व्यक्ति के प्राण का दाम परमेश्वर को चुका सकता है,
hi.R: कोई भी परमेश्वर को इतना नहीं दे सकता \q कि किसी दूसरे का जीवन बच जाए।

ru.L: Брата — никто никак не выкупит; \q никто не даст Богу выкупа за него,
ru.B: Никто не может выкупить жизнь другого \q или заплатить Богу цену за его жизнь,
ru.R: Никто не может заплатить Богу столько, \q чтобы спасти жизнь другого человека.

ja.L: 兄弟を――[人は]決して贖うことはできない。 \q 神に、その身代金を払うことはできない。
ja.B: だれも、ほかの人の命を買い戻すことは決してできない。 \q その人の命の代価を、神に払うこともできない。
ja.R: だれも、ほかの人の命を救うために、 \q 神に十分な代価を払うことはできない。

uk.L: Брата — ніяк не можна викупити; \q ніхто не може дати Богові викупу за [нього],
uk.B: Ніхто ніколи не може викупити життя іншого \q чи заплатити Богові ціну за життя тієї людини,
uk.R: Ніхто не може заплатити Богові стільки, \q щоб урятувати чиєсь життя.

decisions.choice: a brother: no one can ransom even a brother
alternatives: surely (with different vowels): truly no one can ransom himself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with "a brother": no one can buy back even a brother's life. With different vowels the word would mean "surely", and some Hebrew manuscripts read it so. Either way, no wealth can buy anyone free from death.

decisions.choice: ransom: a price paid to set a life free
decisions.reason: In the law, a ransom (kofer) could be paid for a life that was forfeit (Exodus 30:12). Before death no price is enough; only God can ransom (verse 16).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 9 is an aside and verse 10 finishes the thought ("that he should live on forever"), so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: ransom (padah) as "ዋጀ", the ransom price (kofer) as "ቤዛ"
decisions.reason: "ዋጀ" and "ቤዛ" are the Amharic words for buying a life free (Exodus 30:12; Matthew 20:28 "ቤዛ"); the same pair returns in verses 9 and 16, where God does what no one else can.

decisions.choice: छुड़ाना; छुड़ौती (L); दाम (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ransom is the price paid to set a life free: छुड़ौती at Literal, as in Matthew 20:28, and दाम (price) at Balanced and Readable; the verb is छुड़ाना, used again for what God does in verse 16.

decisions.choice: 'ach "兄弟を" (L), "ほかの人の命" (B, R); padah "贖う" (L), "買い戻す" (B); kofer "身代金" (L), "代価" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Masoretic "a brother" is kept at Literal (m1, uncertain, footnoted); a price paid to set a life free (m2). The sentence runs on to 49:10 (m3); each verse closes in Japanese.

source.text: וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and costly [is the] ransom of their soul, and it fails forever,

en.L: for the ransom of their soul is costly, and [it] fails forever,
en.B: for the price of a life is far too high, and no payment could ever be enough,
en.R: The price of a life is far too high. No one could ever pay it.

fr.L: car le rachat de leur âme est coûteux, et [il] manque pour toujours,
fr.B: car le prix d’une vie est bien trop élevé, et aucun paiement ne suffirait jamais,
fr.R: Le prix d’une vie est bien trop élevé. Personne ne pourrait jamais le payer.

sw.L: kwa maana fidia ya nafsi yao ni ghali, nayo inashindikana milele,
sw.B: kwa maana gharama ya uhai ni kubwa mno, wala hakuna malipo yatakayotosha kamwe,
sw.R: Gharama ya maisha ni kubwa mno. Hakuna mtu atakayeweza kuilipa kamwe.

es.L: porque el rescate de su alma es costoso, y [nunca] alcanzará jamás,
es.B: porque el precio de una vida es demasiado alto, y ningún pago bastaría nunca,
es.R: El precio de una vida es demasiado alto. Nadie podría pagarlo nunca.

vi.L: vì giá chuộc linh hồn họ thật đắt, và [nó] không bao giờ đủ,
vi.B: vì giá của một mạng sống quá đắt, không khoản tiền nào trả cho đủ,
vi.R: Giá của một mạng sống quá đắt. Không ai có thể trả nổi.

ko.L: 그들의 영혼의 속량값은 비싸서 영원히 [그것을] 그만두어야 한다.
ko.B: 생명의 값은 너무도 비싸서 어떤 값으로도 끝내 치를 수 없다.
ko.R: 목숨의 값은 너무 비싸다. 아무도 그 값을 치를 수 없다.

pt.L: pois o resgate da alma deles é caro, e [ele] falha para sempre,
pt.B: pois o preço de uma vida é alto demais, e nenhum pagamento jamais bastaria,
pt.R: O preço de uma vida é alto demais. Ninguém jamais poderia pagá-lo.

am.L: የነፍሳቸው ቤዛ ውድ ነውና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጓደላል፤
am.B: የሕይወት ዋጋ እጅግ ውድ ነውና፤ የትኛውም ክፍያ ፈጽሞ አይበቃም፤
am.R: የሕይወት ዋጋ እጅግ ውድ ነው። ማንም ሊከፍለው አይችልም።

hi.L: क्योंकि उनके प्राण की छुड़ौती महँगी है, \q और [वह] सदा के लिए चुक जाती है,
hi.B: क्योंकि प्राण का दाम बहुत ही ऊँचा है, \q और कोई भी भुगतान कभी पूरा न होगा,
hi.R: प्राण का दाम बहुत ही ऊँचा है। \q कोई भी उसे कभी चुका नहीं सकता।

ru.L: ведь дорог выкуп за душу их, \q и [его] не хватит вовек,
ru.B: ведь цена жизни слишком высока, \q и никакой платы никогда не будет довольно,
ru.R: Цена жизни слишком высока. \q Никто никогда не сможет её заплатить.

ja.L: まことに、彼らの魂の贖いの代価は高く、 \q とこしえに[払うことは]かなわない。
ja.B: 命の代価はあまりに高く、 \q どんな支払いも足りることはない。
ja.R: 命の値段は高すぎる。 \q だれも、それを払うことはできない。

uk.L: бо викуп за їхню душу дорогий, \q і [його] не стане ніколи,
uk.B: бо ціна життя надто висока, \q і жодної плати ніколи не вистачить,
uk.R: Ціна життя надто висока. \q Ніхто ніколи не зміг би її заплатити.

decisions.choice: it fails forever: the payment can never be made
decisions.reason: The verb (chadal) means to stop or leave off: the ransom always falls short, or one must give up trying to pay it.

decisions.choice: their soul: their life
decisions.reason: Soul (nefesh) is the person's life itself, which is what is at stake.

decisions.choice: "âme" for nefesh at Literal, "vie" at Balanced and Readable, for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: Nefesh is the whole living person and its life (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the traditional word "âme", so the reader sees where nefesh stands; Balanced and Readable say "vie", "moi" or a plain pronoun, as the English does with "life" and "self".

decisions.choice: "linh hồn" for nefesh at Literal; "mạng sống" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "linh hồn" (soul) for nefesh at Literal; here it means the person's life (see the meaning decision), which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "영혼" (soul) at Literal; Balanced and Readable "생명", "목숨" (life)
decisions.reason: As the terms note: nefesh is "영혼" at Literal; here it means a person's life (meaning decision m2), which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "とこしえに[払うことは]かなわない" (L)
decisions.reason: The payment can never be made (m1); their soul is their life (m2).

source.text: וִֽיחִי־ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: that he should live still forever, not see the pit.

en.L: that {{gender:they|he}} should live on forever [and] not see the pit.
en.B: so that anyone could live on forever and never see the grave.
en.R: Nobody can pay to live forever and never go down to the grave.

fr.L: pour qu’on vive encore à jamais [et] ne voie pas la fosse.
fr.B: pour que quelqu’un puisse vivre toujours sans jamais voir la tombe.
fr.R: Personne ne peut payer pour vivre toujours sans jamais descendre dans la tombe.

sw.L: ili aishi milele [na] asione shimo.
sw.B: ili mtu yeyote aendelee kuishi milele asiuone kamwe kaburi.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kulipa ili aishi milele bila kushuka kaburini.

es.L: para que viva todavía para siempre [y] no vea la fosa.
es.B: para que alguien viva para siempre y nunca vea la tumba.
es.R: Nadie puede pagar para vivir para siempre y no bajar nunca a la tumba.

vi.L: để họ sẽ sống mãi mãi [và] không thấy huyệt mộ.
vi.B: để có ai được sống mãi mãi và không bao giờ thấy mồ mả.
vi.R: Không ai có thể trả tiền để được sống mãi và không bao giờ phải xuống mồ.

ko.L: 그가 영원히 계속 살아서 구덩이를 보지 않도록.
ko.B: 그래서 누구든 영원히 살아서 무덤을 보지 않게 할 수는 없다.
ko.R: 누구도 돈을 주고 영원히 살 수는 없고, 무덤에 내려가지 않을 수도 없다.

pt.L: para que [alguém] continue vivendo para sempre [e] não veja a cova.
pt.B: para que alguém pudesse viver para sempre e nunca ver a sepultura.
pt.R: Ninguém pode pagar para viver para sempre e nunca descer à sepultura.

am.L: ለዘላለም በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ፣ ጉድጓድንም እንዳያይ።
am.B: ማንም ለዘላለም እንዲኖርና መቃብርን ከቶ እንዳያይ።
am.R: ማንም ከፍሎ ለዘላለም ሊኖርና ወደ መቃብር ሳይወርድ ሊቀር አይችልም።

hi.L: कि वह सदा जीवित रहे \q [और] गड्ढे को न देखे।
hi.B: कि कोई सदा जीवित रहे \q और क़ब्र को कभी न देखे।
hi.R: कोई भी पैसे देकर सदा जीवित नहीं रह सकता \q और क़ब्र में जाने से नहीं बच सकता।

ru.L: чтобы [человек] жил ещё вечно \q [и] не увидел ямы.
ru.B: чтобы кто-то мог жить вечно \q и никогда не увидеть могилы.
ru.R: Никто не может заплатить за то, \q чтобы жить вечно и никогда не сойти в могилу.

ja.L: [それは]その人が、とこしえに生き続け、 \q 穴を見ないようにするため[の代価である]。
ja.B: だれかが、いつまでも生き続けて、 \q 滅びの穴を見ないですむようにするためには。
ja.R: だれも、お金を払って、いつまでも生き、 \q 墓に下らずにすむことはできない。

uk.L: щоб жити далі вічно \q [й] не побачити ями.
uk.B: щоб хтось міг жити вічно \q й ніколи не побачити могили.
uk.R: Ніхто не може заплатити, \q щоб жити вічно й ніколи не зійти в могилу.

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave
decisions.reason: The pit (shachat) is the grave, the place of the dead (16:10; 30:10).

decisions.choice: see the pit: die
decisions.reason: To see a thing is to experience it; to see the pit is to die.

decisions.choice: they, with "he" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The verb is about anyone at all.

decisions.choice: no gender setting for "on" at Literal
decisions.reason: The English needs the setting on "they" or "he"; French "on" already means anyone, so the sentence needs none.

decisions.choice: [alguém], with no gender setting
alternatives: a gender setting on a pronoun
decisions.reason: Where the English Literal puts "they" / "he" under the gender setting, Portuguese needs no pronoun: the verb has no subject pronoun, and the supplied "alguém" already means anyone. So this verse and verses 17-20 have no gender span (the English decision r-en-1 is met by the wording itself).

decisions.choice: the pit (shachat) as "ጉድጓድ" (Literal), "መቃብር" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say "the grave", as the English does and as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: गड्ढा (L); क़ब्र (B, R)
decisions.reason: The pit (shachat) is the grave: गड्ढा at Literal and क़ब्र at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry note has it.

decisions.choice: "[человек]" without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender setting here; the Russian says it with "человек", "кто-то" or a pronoun that refers to them, which already take in men and women, so it needs none (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: "яма" (L); "могила" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's forms for the pit, the grave (m1).

decisions.choice: shachat "穴" (L), "滅びの穴" (B), "墓" (R)
decisions.reason: shachat as the pit of death (PSA-1, as JOB); seeing the pit is dying (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה׀חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For he sees [that] wise [people] die; together [the] fool and [the] stupid perish and leave to others their wealth.

en.L: For [one] sees [that the] wise die; together [the] fool and [the] dull perish and leave their wealth to others.
en.B: Anyone can see it: wise people die, and fools and dullards perish with them, handing over their wealth to others.
en.R: Everyone can see that even wise people die. Foolish and stupid people die too. Then other people get their money.

fr.L: Car [on] voit [que les] sages meurent ; ensemble [l’]insensé et [le] stupide périssent et laissent à d’autres leur fortune.
fr.B: Chacun le voit : les sages meurent, et l’insensé comme l’imbécile périssent avec eux, laissant leur fortune à d’autres.
fr.R: Tout le monde peut voir que même les sages meurent. Les insensés et les gens stupides meurent aussi. Puis d’autres prennent leur argent.

sw.L: Kwa maana [mtu] anaona [kwamba] wenye hekima hufa; mpumbavu na asiye na akili huangamia pamoja na kuwaachia wengine mali yao.
sw.B: Kila mtu anaweza kuona: wenye hekima hufa, na wapumbavu na wasio na akili huangamia pamoja nao, wakiwaachia wengine mali zao.
sw.R: Kila mtu anaweza kuona kwamba hata watu wenye hekima hufa. Wapumbavu na watu wasio na akili hufa pia. Kisha watu wengine wanachukua fedha zao.

es.L: Porque [uno] ve [que los] sabios mueren; juntos perecen [el] necio y [el] torpe y dejan sus riquezas a otros.
es.B: Cualquiera lo ve: los sabios mueren, y los necios y los torpes perecen con ellos, y dejan sus riquezas a otros.
es.R: Todos pueden ver que hasta los sabios mueren. Los necios y los tontos también mueren. Y después otros se quedan con su dinero.

vi.L: Vì [người ta] thấy [rằng] người khôn ngoan chết; kẻ ngu dại và kẻ đần độn cùng nhau tiêu vong và để lại của cải mình cho người khác.
vi.B: Ai cũng thấy: người khôn ngoan rồi cũng chết, kẻ ngu dại và kẻ đần độn cũng tiêu vong như vậy, và để lại của cải cho người khác.
vi.R: Ai cũng thấy rằng ngay cả người khôn ngoan cũng chết. Người ngu dại và người khờ khạo cũng chết. Rồi người khác lấy hết tiền bạc của họ.

ko.L: 이는 [누구나] 지혜로운 자들이 죽는 것을 보기 때문이다. 미련한 자와 우둔한 자가 함께 망하고, 그들의 재물을 남들에게 남긴다.
ko.B: 누구나 보듯이 지혜로운 사람도 죽고, 미련한 자와 어리석은 자도 함께 망하여, 그들의 재물을 남에게 넘겨준다.
ko.R: 누구나 알 수 있듯이 지혜로운 사람도 죽는다. 미련하고 어리석은 사람도 죽는다. 그러면 다른 사람들이 그들의 돈을 가져간다.

pt.L: Pois [alguém] vê [que os] sábios morrem; juntos [o] tolo e [o] insensato perecem e deixam a sua riqueza para outros.
pt.B: Qualquer um pode ver: os sábios morrem, e os tolos e os insensatos perecem com eles, entregando a sua riqueza a outros.
pt.R: Todos podem ver que até as pessoas sábias morrem. As pessoas tolas e sem juízo também morrem. Depois, outras pessoas ficam com o dinheiro delas.

am.L: ጠቢባን እንደሚሞቱ ያያልና፤ ሞኝና ደንቆሮ በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ፤ ሀብታቸውንም ለሌሎች ይተዋሉ።
am.B: ማንም ሊያየው ይችላል፤ ጠቢባን ይሞታሉ፤ ሞኞችና ደንቆሮዎችም አብረዋቸው ይጠፋሉ፤ ሀብታቸውንም ለሌሎች ያስረክባሉ።
am.R: ጠቢባን እንኳ እንደሚሞቱ ሁሉም ያያል። ሞኞችና ደንቆሮዎችም ይሞታሉ። ከዚያም ገንዘባቸው ለሌሎች ይሆናል።

hi.L: क्योंकि [कोई भी] देखता है [कि] बुद्धिमान मरते हैं; \q मूर्ख और जड़बुद्धि एक साथ नाश होते हैं \q और अपना धन दूसरों के लिए छोड़ जाते हैं।
hi.B: कोई भी देख सकता है: \q बुद्धिमान मरते हैं, और मूर्ख और जड़बुद्धि भी उनके साथ नाश होते हैं, \q और अपना धन दूसरों को सौंप जाते हैं।
hi.R: हर कोई देख सकता है कि बुद्धिमान लोग भी मरते हैं। \q मूर्ख और नासमझ लोग भी मरते हैं। \q फिर उनका पैसा दूसरे लोगों को मिल जाता है।

ru.L: Ведь [каждый] видит: мудрые умирают; \q вместе глупый и невежда погибают \q и оставляют другим богатство своё.
ru.B: Каждый может это увидеть: \q мудрые умирают, и глупцы и невежды гибнут вместе с ними, \q оставляя своё богатство другим.
ru.R: Все видят, что даже мудрые люди умирают. \q Глупые и неразумные люди тоже умирают. \q Потом их деньги получают другие.

ja.L: まことに、[人は]見る、知恵ある者も死に、 \q 愚かな者も鈍い者も共に滅び、 \q その富を他人に残すのを。
ja.B: だれでも見てわかる。 \q 知恵ある人も死に、愚かな者も鈍い者も、共に滅びて、 \q その財産を他人に残す。
ja.R: だれにでもわかることだ。賢い人でも死ぬ。 \q 愚かな人や、ものがわからない人も死ぬ。 \q そして、ほかの人がその人たちのお金を手に入れる。

uk.L: Бо [кожен] бачить, [що] мудрі вмирають; \q разом безумний і тупий гинуть \q і залишають своє багатство іншим.
uk.B: Кожен може це побачити: \q мудрі вмирають, і безумні та тупі гинуть разом із ними, \q передаючи своє багатство іншим.
uk.R: Кожен бачить, що навіть мудрі люди вмирають. \q Нерозумні й дурні люди теж умирають. \q Тоді інші люди отримують їхні гроші.

decisions.choice: he sees: anyone can see
decisions.reason: The subject of "sees" is not named; it is anyone who looks, or the rich man himself, who sees death all around and still trusts in his wealth.

decisions.choice: fool, stupid: people without sense
decisions.reason: The fool (kesil) and the brutish (ba'ar) are people who do not use the sense God gave them; the second word is related to the word for cattle (73:22).

decisions.choice: leave their wealth to others
decisions.reason: Ecclesiastes 2:18-21 makes the same complaint, and Jesus tells of a rich fool whose wealth goes to others (Luke 12:20).

decisions.choice: the fool (kesil) as "ሞኝ", the brutish (ba'ar) as "ደንቆሮ"
decisions.reason: "ሞኝ" is the terms list's word for kesil; "ደንቆሮ" (dull, senseless) keeps the second word apart from it.

decisions.choice: kesil "愚かな者", ba'ar "鈍い者" (L, B)
decisions.reason: People without sense (m2), kept as two words as in Proverbs.

source.text: קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ׀לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Their inward [thought: their] houses forever, their dwellings to generation and generation; they called by their names on lands.

en.L: Their inward [thought is that] their houses [are] forever, their dwelling places to generation and generation; they have called [their] lands by their own names.
en.B: They imagine their houses will last forever, their homes for all generations; they have named whole estates after themselves.
en.R: They think their houses will last forever and their families will live in them for all time. They name their lands after themselves.

fr.L: Leur pensée intime : leurs maisons [sont] pour toujours, leurs demeures de génération en génération ; ils ont appelé [leurs] terres de leurs noms.
fr.B: Ils s’imaginent que leurs maisons dureront toujours, leurs demeures pour toutes les générations ; ils ont donné leur nom à des domaines entiers.
fr.R: Ils pensent que leurs maisons dureront toujours et que leurs familles y vivront pour toujours. Ils donnent leur propre nom à leurs terres.

sw.L: Wazo lao la ndani [ni kwamba] nyumba zao [ni] za milele, makao yao kizazi hata kizazi; wameziita nchi kwa majina yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Wanadhani nyumba zao zitadumu milele, makao yao kwa vizazi vyote; wameyapa mashamba makubwa majina yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Wanafikiri nyumba zao zitadumu milele, na jamaa zao wataishi humo siku zote. Wanaziita ardhi zao kwa majina yao.

es.L: Su pensamiento íntimo [es que] sus casas [son] para siempre, sus moradas de generación en generación; han llamado [sus] tierras con sus propios nombres.
es.B: Se imaginan que sus casas durarán para siempre, sus hogares por todas las generaciones; han puesto su propio nombre a fincas enteras.
es.R: Creen que sus casas durarán para siempre y que sus familias vivirán en ellas por todos los tiempos. Ponen su propio nombre a sus tierras.

vi.L: Ý nghĩ thầm kín của họ [là] nhà của họ [còn] mãi mãi, chỗ ở của họ [còn] đến đời này qua đời kia; họ đã lấy tên mình đặt cho đất đai.
vi.B: Họ tưởng nhà cửa mình sẽ còn mãi mãi, chỗ ở của mình còn đến muôn đời; họ lấy tên mình đặt cho cả những vùng đất.
vi.R: Họ nghĩ nhà cửa của họ sẽ còn mãi và gia đình họ sẽ sống ở đó đời đời. Họ lấy tên mình đặt cho đất đai của họ.

ko.L: 그들 속[생각에는] 그들의 집들이 영원하고, 그들의 거처들이 대대로 [있을 것이라 한다]. 그들은 땅들을 자기들의 이름으로 불렀다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기들의 집이 영원하고, 자기들의 거처가 대대로 이어지리라 생각한다. 그들은 땅에 자기 이름을 붙였다.
ko.R: 그들은 자기 집이 영원히 남고, 자기 집안이 언제까지나 거기서 살 거라고 생각한다. 그들은 자기 땅에 자기 이름을 붙인다.

pt.L: O pensamento íntimo deles [é que] as suas casas [são] para sempre, as suas moradas de geração em geração; eles deram às [suas] terras os seus próprios nomes.
pt.B: Eles imaginam que as suas casas vão durar para sempre, as suas moradas por todas as gerações; deram o próprio nome a propriedades inteiras.
pt.R: Eles pensam que as suas casas vão durar para sempre e que a família deles vai morar nelas o tempo todo. Eles dão o próprio nome às suas terras.

am.L: የውስጥ [ሐሳባቸው] ቤቶቻቸው ለዘላለም፣ መኖሪያዎቻቸውም ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ [እንደሚኖሩ ነው]፤ ምድሮቻቸውንም በስማቸው ጠሩ።
am.B: ቤቶቻቸው ለዘላለም፣ መኖሪያዎቻቸውም ለትውልድ ሁሉ የሚኖሩ ይመስላቸዋል፤ ርስቶቻቸውንም በራሳቸው ስም ሰይመዋል።
am.R: ቤቶቻቸው ለዘላለም እንደሚኖሩ፣ ቤተሰቦቻቸውም ሁልጊዜ በውስጣቸው እንደሚኖሩ ያስባሉ። ምድሮቻቸውንም በራሳቸው ስም ይሰይማሉ።

hi.L: उनके भीतर का [विचार यह है कि] उनके घर सदा के लिए [हैं], \q उनके निवासस्थान पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक; \q उन्होंने [अपनी] भूमि को अपने ही नामों से पुकारा है।
hi.B: वे सोचते हैं कि उनके घर सदा बने रहेंगे, \q उनके निवास सब पीढ़ियों तक; \q उन्होंने पूरी-पूरी जागीरों के नाम अपने नाम पर रखे हैं।
hi.R: वे सोचते हैं कि उनके घर सदा बने रहेंगे \q और उनके परिवार सदा उनमें रहेंगे। \q वे अपनी ज़मीनों के नाम अपने नाम पर रखते हैं।

ru.L: Их внутреннее [мнение — что] дома их — навеки, \q жилища их — в род и род; \q они называли [свои] земли своими именами.
ru.B: Они воображают, что их дома будут стоять вечно, \q их жилища — во все поколения; \q они называют целые поместья своими именами.
ru.R: Они думают, что их дома будут стоять вечно \q и их семьи будут жить в них всегда. \q Они дают своим землям свои имена.

ja.L: 彼らの内なる[思い]は、その家はとこしえに、 \q その住まいは代々に[続く、ということ]。 \q 彼らは土地を自分の名で呼んだ。
ja.B: 彼らは、自分の家がとこしえに、 \q その住まいが代々に続くと思い込み、 \q 広い土地に自分の名をつけた。
ja.R: 彼らは、自分の家がいつまでも残り、 \q 自分の家族がずっとそこに住むと思っている。 \q 自分の土地に、自分の名前をつける。

uk.L: Їхня внутрішня [думка — що] їхні доми — навіки, \q їхні оселі — з роду в рід; \q вони назвали [свої] землі своїми іменами.
uk.B: Вони уявляють, що їхні доми стоятимуть вічно, \q а їхні оселі — для всіх поколінь; \q вони назвали цілі маєтки на свою честь.
uk.R: Вони думають, що їхні доми стоятимуть вічно \q і що їхні родини житимуть у них завжди. \q Вони називають свої землі своїми іменами.

decisions.choice: their inward thought: what they think
alternatives: their graves (the ancient Greek translation): their graves are their homes forever
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "their inside", that is, their inner thought. The ancient Greek and Syriac translations read the same letters in a different order, "their graves": "their graves are their houses forever", a bitter irony. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: they called by their names on lands: they named estates after themselves
decisions.reason: To call land by one's name is to claim it as one's own (2 Samuel 12:28).

decisions.choice: They imagine (B); They think (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "their inward" means (m1).

decisions.choice: qirbam "彼らの内なる[思い]" (L), "思い込み" (B), "思っている" (R)
decisions.reason: The Masoretic "their inward part" read as what they think (m1, uncertain, footnoted); other witnesses read "their graves".

source.text: וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל־יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: But humankind in honor not remains; he is like the animals [that] perish.

en.L: But {{gender:humankind|man}} in honor does not remain; {{gender:they are|he is}} like the animals [that] perish.
en.B: Yet no one, however honored, stays for long; humans are no different from animals that die.
en.R: Rich and famous people do not last forever. They die, just like animals.

fr.L: Mais {{gender:l’humain|l’homme}} dans l’honneur ne demeure pas ; il est semblable aux bêtes [qui] périssent.
fr.B: Pourtant personne, si honoré soit-il, ne reste longtemps ; {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} ne valent pas mieux que les bêtes qui meurent.
fr.R: Les gens riches et célèbres ne durent pas toujours. Ils meurent, comme les animaux.

sw.L: Lakini mwanadamu katika heshima hadumu; yeye ni kama wanyama wanaoangamia.
sw.B: Lakini hakuna mtu, hata akiheshimiwa vipi, anayekaa muda mrefu; wanadamu hawana tofauti na wanyama wanaokufa.
sw.R: Watu matajiri na maarufu hawadumu milele. Wanakufa, kama wanyama.

es.L: Pero el {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} en honra no permanece; es como los animales [que] perecen.
es.B: Pero nadie, por muy honrado que sea, se queda mucho tiempo; los seres humanos no son distintos de los animales que mueren.
es.R: Los ricos y famosos no duran para siempre. Mueren igual que los animales.

vi.L: Nhưng loài người trong sự vinh hiển không ở lại lâu; họ giống như các con thú [bị] tiêu diệt.
vi.B: Thế nhưng không ai, dù được tôn trọng đến đâu, được ở lại lâu dài; con người chẳng khác gì loài thú phải chết.
vi.R: Người giàu và nổi tiếng không sống mãi được. Họ chết, giống như loài thú.

ko.L: 그러나 사람은 영화 가운데 머물러 있지 못한다. 사람은 멸망하는 짐승들과 같다.
ko.B: 아무리 존귀한 사람이라도 오래 머물지 못하니, 사람은 죽어 없어지는 짐승과 다를 바 없다.
ko.R: 부자이고 유명한 사람들도 영원히 살지 못한다. 그들도 짐승처럼 죽는다.

pt.L: Mas {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} em honra não permanece; é semelhante aos animais [que] perecem.
pt.B: Mas ninguém, por mais honrado que seja, permanece por muito tempo; o ser humano não é diferente dos animais que morrem.
pt.R: Pessoas ricas e famosas não duram para sempre. Elas morrem, como os animais.

am.L: ሰው ግን በክብር አያድርም፤ እንደሚጠፉ እንስሳት ነው።
am.B: ማንም ምንም ያህል ቢከበር ለረጅም ጊዜ አይቆይም፤ ሰው ከሚሞቱ እንስሳት አይለይም።
am.R: ሀብታሞችና ታዋቂዎች ለዘላለም አይኖሩም። እንደ እንስሳት ይሞታሉ።

hi.L: परंतु मनुष्य आदर में बना नहीं रहता; \q वह नाश होनेवाले पशुओं के समान है।
hi.B: फिर भी कोई, चाहे कितना ही आदर पाए, बहुत दिन नहीं टिकता; \q मनुष्य मरनेवाले पशुओं से अलग नहीं हैं।
hi.R: धनी और प्रसिद्ध लोग सदा नहीं रहते। \q वे पशुओं की तरह मर जाते हैं।

ru.L: Но человек в чести не пребудет; \q он подобен животным, [которые] погибают.
ru.B: Но никто, как бы его ни почитали, не остаётся надолго; \q люди ничем не отличаются от животных, которые умирают.
ru.R: Богатые и знаменитые люди не живут вечно. \q Они умирают, как животные.

ja.L: しかし、人は栄誉のうちにとどまることはない。 \q 滅びる獣に等しい。
ja.B: しかし、どれほど栄誉ある人も、長くはとどまらない。 \q 人は、死んでいく獣と何も変わらない。
ja.R: お金持ちや有名な人も、いつまでも生きているわけではない。 \q 動物と同じように死ぬ。

uk.L: Але людина в пошані не залишається; \q вона подібна до тварин, [що] гинуть.
uk.B: Та ніхто, хоч як шанований, не залишається надовго; \q люди нічим не відрізняються від тварин, що вмирають.
uk.R: Багаті й відомі люди не живуть вічно. \q Вони вмирають, так само як тварини.

decisions.choice: remain: stay, as for a night
alternatives: understand (some ancient translations, as in verse 21)
decisions.reason: The verb (lun) means to stay the night: honor is a lodging for one night only. Verse 21 repeats the line with one letter changed, "does not understand".

decisions.choice: honor: wealth and standing
decisions.reason: The word (yeqar) is preciousness: costly things, and the honor they bring.

decisions.choice: the refrain: the proverb of verse 5
decisions.reason: This line and verse 21 are the refrain of the psalm, probably the "proverb" announced in verse 5.

decisions.choice: humankind, they are (with "man", "he is" as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The word ('adam) is human beings in general.

decisions.choice: "l'humain" (Literal) and "les humains" (Balanced), with "l'homme" and "les hommes" as the alternatives; the pronoun "il" that refers back takes no setting
decisions.reason: Adam here is human beings in general. French puts the setting on the noun only; the English also puts it on the pronoun, which French does not need, since "il" after "l'humain" is ordinary generic French.

decisions.choice: o ser humano, with "o homem" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the English; the second English span ("they are" / "he is") has no Portuguese counterpart, since "é" serves for both. The same wording returns in the refrain of verse 21.

decisions.choice: "does not remain" (lun) as "አያድርም" (does not stay the night)
decisions.reason: The verb is to lodge for a night (see the meaning decision), which "አደረ" says exactly. The refrain returns in verse 21 in the same words, with only "does not understand" changed, as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "человек", "он" without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender setting here; the Russian says it with "человек", "кто-то" or a pronoun that refers to them, which already take in men and women, so it needs none (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: The refrain "滅びる獣に等しい" (L), "死んでいく獣と何も変わらない" (B), "動物と同じように死ぬ" (R), repeated in 49:21
decisions.reason: yalin is to stay, as for a night (m1); the refrain answers the proverb of 49:5 (m3), and its wording returns in 49:21.

source.text: זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם׀בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] their way, folly [belongs] to them, and after them in their mouth they delight. Selah.

en.L: This [is] the way of those who have folly, and after them [people] delight in their mouth. Selah
en.B: Such is the road of the foolishly self-assured, and of those who come after them and like what they say. Selah
en.R: This is what happens to people who are sure of themselves. It also happens to those who follow them and agree with what they say. Selah

fr.L: Tel [est] le chemin de ceux qui ont de la folie, et après eux [on] se plaît à leur bouche. Sélah
fr.B: Tel est le chemin de ceux qui ont une sotte assurance, et de ceux qui viennent après eux et aiment ce qu’ils disent. Sélah
fr.R: Voilà ce qui arrive aux gens qui sont sûrs d’eux. Cela arrive aussi à ceux qui les suivent et approuvent ce qu’ils disent. Sélah

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] njia ya wale walio na upumbavu, na baada yao [watu] hupendezwa na kinywa chao. Sela
sw.B: Hiyo ndiyo njia ya wale wanaojiamini kwa upumbavu, na ya wale wanaowafuata na kupenda maneno yao. Sela
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo inavyowapata watu wanaojiamini wao wenyewe. Inawapata pia wale wanaowafuata na kukubaliana na wanayoyasema. Sela

es.L: Este [es] el camino de los que tienen necedad, y tras ellos [otros] se complacen en lo que dicen. Selah
es.B: Ese es el camino de los que confían neciamente en sí mismos, y de los que vienen detrás y aprueban lo que dicen. Selah
es.R: Esto es lo que les pasa a los que están muy seguros de sí mismos. También les pasa a los que los siguen y están de acuerdo con lo que dicen. Selah

vi.L: Đây [là] con đường của những kẻ ngu dại, và sau họ [người ta] vẫn ưa thích lời miệng của họ. Sê-la
vi.B: Đó là con đường của những kẻ tự tin cách ngu dại, và của những người theo sau họ, ưa thích lời họ nói. Sê-la
vi.R: Đây là điều xảy đến cho những người quá tự tin vào mình. Điều đó cũng xảy đến cho những người theo họ và đồng ý với lời họ nói. Sê-la

ko.L: 이것이 어리석음을 가진 자들의 길이요, 그들 뒤에 [오는 자들이] 그들의 입을 기뻐한다. 셀라.
ko.B: 이것이 어리석게도 자신만만한 자들의 길이요, 그들의 뒤를 따르며 그들의 말을 좋아하는 자들의 길이다. 셀라.
ko.R: 이것이 자기를 믿고 자신만만한 사람들에게 일어나는 일이다. 그들을 따르며 그들의 말에 맞장구치는 사람들에게도 똑같은 일이 일어난다. 셀라.

pt.L: Este [é] o caminho dos que têm insensatez, e depois deles [outros] se agradam da sua boca. Selá
pt.B: Esse é o caminho dos que confiam tolamente em si mesmos, e dos que vêm depois deles e aprovam o que eles dizem. Selá
pt.R: É isso que acontece com as pessoas que confiam demais em si mesmas. Acontece também com quem as segue e concorda com o que elas dizem. Selá

am.L: ሞኝነት ያላቸው ሰዎች መንገድ ይህ ነው፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ [ሰዎች] በአፋቸው ደስ ይላቸዋል። ሴላ
am.B: በሞኝነት በራሳቸው የሚተማመኑ ሰዎችና ከእነርሱ በኋላ መጥተው በቃላቸው ደስ የሚሰኙ ሰዎች መንገድ ይህ ነው። ሴላ
am.R: በራሳቸው የሚተማመኑ ሰዎች መጨረሻ ይህ ነው። የሚከተሏቸውና በሚናገሩት የሚስማሙ ሰዎችም መጨረሻ ይኸው ነው። ሴላ

hi.L: यह उनका मार्ग [है] जिनमें मूर्खता है, \q और उनके बाद [लोग] उनके मुँह [की बातों] से प्रसन्न होते हैं। सेला
hi.B: यही उन लोगों की राह है जो मूर्खता से अपने आप पर भरोसा रखते हैं, \q और उनकी भी जो उनके बाद आकर उनकी बातें पसंद करते हैं। सेला
hi.R: यही उन लोगों के साथ होता है जो अपने आप पर बहुत भरोसा करते हैं। \q यही उनके साथ भी होता है जो उनके पीछे चलते हैं और उनकी बातों से सहमत होते हैं। सेला

ru.L: Таков путь [тех, у кого] глупость, \q и после них [люди] одобряют их уста. Села
ru.B: Таков путь глупо самоуверенных и тех, \q кто приходит после них и одобряет их слова. Села
ru.R: Вот что случается с людьми, которые уверены в себе. \q Это случается и с теми, кто следует за ними и соглашается с их словами. Села

ja.L: これが、愚かさを持つ者たちの道。 \q 彼らの後に[来る人々]は、彼らの口[の言葉]を喜ぶ。セラ
ja.B: これが、愚かにも自分を信じる者たちの道であり、 \q その後に続いて、彼らの言うことを好む者たちの道である。セラ
ja.R: これが、自分は大丈夫だと思い込んでいる人たちに起こることだ。 \q その人たちに従い、その言うことに賛成する人たちにも、同じことが起こる。セラ

uk.L: Це — дорога тих, хто має безумство, \q і після них [люди] втішаються їхніми устами. Села
uk.B: Такий шлях безглуздо самовпевнених і тих, \q хто йде за ними й схвалює, що вони кажуть. Села
uk.R: Ось що стається з людьми, які певні себе. \q Те саме стається з тими, хто йде за ними й погоджується з тим, що вони кажуть. Села

decisions.choice: folly: foolish confidence
decisions.reason: The word (kesel) can mean folly or confidence; here both: a confidence that is foolish.

decisions.choice: after them they delight in their mouth: followers approve their words
alternatives: after them they run to their own mouth
decisions.reason: The line is hard. It seems to say that people who come after them still admire what they said, though it led to death.

decisions.choice: their way: the road they take and where it ends
decisions.reason: Way (derek) is a path of life and its end, as in 1:6.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The word's meaning is no longer known; it is probably a musical direction (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "셀라" kept at the end of the verse, as throughout these psalms
decisions.reason: A word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (meaning decision m4); see Psalm 46:4.

decisions.choice: "Села" at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As in 44:9: a word whose meaning is no longer known, kept at every level.

decisions.choice: kesel "愚かさ" (L), "愚かにも自分を信じる" (B), "自分は大丈夫だと思い込んでいる" (R)
decisions.reason: Foolish confidence (m1, uncertain); followers approve their words (m2, uncertain).

source.text: כַּצֹּ֤אן׀לִֽשְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים׀לַבֹּ֗קֶר וְ֭צוּרָם לְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Like the sheep for Sheol they are appointed; death will shepherd them, and [the] upright will rule over them in the morning; and their form [is] for Sheol to wear away, from [a] lofty dwelling for it.

en.L: Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death will shepherd them, and [the] upright will rule over them in the morning; and their form [is] for Sheol to wear away, [with] no lofty dwelling for it.
en.B: Like sheep they are herded into Sheol, and Death is their shepherd. The upright will rule over them when morning comes; their bodies will waste away in Sheol, far from their grand houses.
en.R: Like sheep, they are headed for the place of the dead. Death will lead them like a shepherd. In the morning, good people will rule over them. Their bodies will rot in the grave, far away from their fine homes.

fr.L: Comme des brebis ils sont destinés au Shéol ; la mort les fera paître, et [les hommes] droits domineront sur eux au matin ; et leur forme [est] pour le Shéol, qui l’usera, sans haute demeure pour elle.
fr.B: Comme des brebis on les mène au séjour des morts, et la Mort est leur berger. Les hommes droits domineront sur eux quand viendra le matin ; leur corps s’usera au séjour des morts, loin de leurs riches maisons.
fr.R: Comme des moutons, ils vont vers le séjour des morts. La mort les conduira comme un berger. Au matin, les gens droits régneront sur eux. Leur corps pourrira dans la tombe, loin de leurs belles maisons.

sw.L: Kama kondoo wameandaliwa kwa ajili ya Kuzimu; mauti itawachunga, na wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi; na umbo lao [ni] kwa Kuzimu kuliozesha, [bila] makao ya fahari kwa ajili yake.
sw.B: Kama kondoo wanaswagwa kuingia Kuzimu, na Mauti ndiye mchungaji wao. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi ifikapo; miili yao itaoza Kuzimu, mbali na nyumba zao za fahari.
sw.R: Kama kondoo, wanaelekea Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu. Kifo kitawaongoza kama mchungaji. Asubuhi, watu wema watawatawala. Miili yao itaoza kaburini, mbali na nyumba zao nzuri.

es.L: Como ovejas están destinados al Seol; la muerte los pastoreará, y [los] rectos los dominarán por la mañana; y su figura [es] para que el Seol la consuma, [sin] alta morada para ella.
es.B: Como ovejas son llevados al lugar de los muertos, y la Muerte es su pastor. Los rectos los dominarán cuando llegue la mañana; sus cuerpos se consumirán en el lugar de los muertos, lejos de sus grandes casas.
es.R: Como ovejas, van camino al lugar de los muertos. La muerte los guiará como un pastor. Por la mañana, las personas buenas los dominarán. Sus cuerpos se pudrirán en la tumba, lejos de sus casas lujosas.

vi.L: Như chiên, họ bị định cho Âm Phủ; sự chết sẽ chăn dắt họ, và người ngay thẳng sẽ cai trị họ vào buổi sáng; và hình dạng họ [là] để Âm Phủ làm hao mòn, [không còn] chỗ ở cao sang cho nó.
vi.B: Như bầy chiên, họ bị lùa vào Âm Phủ, và Sự Chết là kẻ chăn dắt họ. Người ngay thẳng sẽ cai trị họ khi buổi sáng đến; thân xác họ sẽ tan rữa trong Âm Phủ, cách xa những ngôi nhà sang trọng của họ.
vi.R: Như bầy chiên, họ đang đi đến nơi của người chết. Sự chết sẽ dẫn họ đi như người chăn chiên. Vào buổi sáng, những người tốt sẽ cai trị họ. Thân xác họ sẽ mục nát trong mồ, xa cách những ngôi nhà đẹp đẽ của họ.

ko.L: 양처럼 그들은 스올로 정해져 있으니, 죽음이 그들을 칠 것이요, 정직한 자들이 아침에 그들을 다스릴 것이다. 그들의 형상은 스올이 닳아 없애도록 [정해졌으니], 그것에게는 높은 거처가 없다.
ko.B: 그들은 양처럼 스올로 몰려가고, 죽음이 그들의 목자가 된다. 아침이 오면 정직한 사람들이 그들을 다스릴 것이다. 그들의 몸은 스올에서 썩어 가고, 화려한 집과는 멀리 떨어질 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 양처럼 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳으로 끌려간다. 죽음이 목자처럼 그들을 끌고 간다. 아침이 되면 선한 사람들이 그들을 다스릴 것이다. 그들의 몸은 무덤에서 썩고, 그들의 좋은 집과는 멀리 떨어질 것이다.

pt.L: Como ovelhas são destinados ao Sheol; a morte os pastoreará, e [os] retos dominarão sobre eles pela manhã; e a sua forma [é] para o Sheol consumir, [sem] morada elevada para ela.
pt.B: Como ovelhas são levados para o mundo dos mortos, e a Morte é o seu pastor. Os retos vão dominar sobre eles quando a manhã chegar; os seus corpos vão se desfazer no mundo dos mortos, longe das suas casas grandiosas.
pt.R: Como ovelhas, eles vão para o mundo dos mortos. A morte vai guiá-los como um pastor. De manhã, as pessoas boas vão dominar sobre eles. Os seus corpos vão apodrecer na sepultura, bem longe das suas belas casas.

am.L: እንደ በጎች ለሲኦል ተመድበዋል፤ ሞት ያሰማራቸዋል፤ ቅኖችም በማለዳ ይገዟቸዋል፤ መልካቸውም ሲኦል ያፈርሰው ዘንድ ነው፤ ከፍ ያለ መኖሪያ የለውም።
am.B: እንደ በጎች ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ይነዳሉ፤ ሞትም እረኛቸው ነው። ማለዳ ሲሆን ቅኖች ይገዟቸዋል፤ ሥጋቸውም ከታላላቅ ቤቶቻቸው ርቆ በሙታን ዓለም ውስጥ ይበሰብሳል።
am.R: እንደ በጎች ወደ ሙታን ዓለም እያመሩ ነው። ሞት እንደ እረኛ ይመራቸዋል። በማለዳ ደጋግ ሰዎች ይገዟቸዋል። ሥጋቸው ከሚያማምሩ ቤቶቻቸው ርቆ በመቃብር ውስጥ ይበሰብሳል።

hi.L: भेड़ों की तरह वे शिओल के लिए ठहराए गए हैं; \q मृत्यु उनकी चरवाही करेगी, और भोर को सीधे लोग उन पर प्रभुता करेंगे; \q और उनका रूप शिओल के द्वारा गल जाने [के लिए है], \q उसके लिए कोई ऊँचा निवास [न रहेगा]।
hi.B: भेड़ों की तरह वे अधोलोक में हाँक दिए जाते हैं, \q और मृत्यु उनकी चरवाहा है। \q भोर होने पर सीधे लोग उन पर प्रभुता करेंगे; \q उनके शरीर अपने भव्य घरों से दूर अधोलोक में गल जाएँगे।
hi.R: भेड़ों की तरह वे मृत्यु के लोक की ओर जा रहे हैं। \q मृत्यु चरवाहे की तरह उन्हें ले जाएगी। \q भोर को भले लोग उन पर राज्य करेंगे। \q उनके शरीर उनके सुंदर घरों से बहुत दूर क़ब्र में सड़ जाएँगे।

ru.L: Как овцы, они назначены в шеол; \q смерть будет пасти их, и прямодушные будут владычествовать над ними наутро; \q и образ их — для шеола, чтобы истлеть, \q [без] высокого жилища для него.
ru.B: Как овец, их загоняют в мир мёртвых, и Смерть — их пастух. \q Честные будут властвовать над ними, когда наступит утро; \q их тела истлеют в мире мёртвых, \q вдали от их роскошных домов.
ru.R: Как овцы, они идут в мир мёртвых. Смерть ведёт их, как пастух. \q Утром добрые люди будут править ими. \q Их тела сгниют в могиле, \q далеко от их прекрасных домов.

ja.L: 羊のように、彼らは陰府に定められている。 \q 死が彼らを牧し、朝には、まっすぐな者たちが彼らを治める。 \q 彼らの姿は、陰府が朽ちさせる[もの]、 \q それには高い住まいもない。
ja.B: 羊のように、彼らは陰府へと追い込まれ、死が彼らの羊飼いとなる。 \q 朝が来ると、心のまっすぐな人たちが彼らを治める。 \q 彼らの体は陰府で朽ち果て、 \q 壮大な住まいから遠く離れる。
ja.R: 羊のように、彼らは死者の世界へと向かっている。死が、羊飼いのように彼らを連れて行く。 \q 朝には、正しく生きる人たちが彼らを治める。 \q 彼らの体は死者の世界で朽ちていく。 \q 立派な家から遠く離れて。

uk.L: Як овець, їх призначено для шеолу; \q смерть пастиме їх, і праведні пануватимуть над ними вранці; \q а їхній образ — для шеолу, щоб стерти, \q [і] немає йому високої оселі.
uk.B: Як овець, їх заганяють у світ мертвих, і Смерть — їхній пастух. \q Праведні пануватимуть над ними, коли настане ранок; \q їхні тіла зотліють у світі мертвих, \q далеко від їхніх пишних домів.
uk.R: Як вівці, вони йдуть до світу мертвих. Смерть вестиме їх, як пастух. \q Уранці добрі люди пануватимуть над ними. \q Їхні тіла згниють у могилі, \q далеко від їхніх гарних домів.

decisions.choice: death will shepherd them: they are led to death like sheep
decisions.reason: Death is pictured as a shepherd driving its flock into Sheol, the place of the dead. The proud rich are like animals (verse 13), and end like them.

decisions.choice: the upright will rule over them in the morning
decisions.reason: Morning is the time of God's help after a night of danger (46:6). When God acts, the upright, who feared the rich, will be over them.

decisions.choice: their form ... no lofty dwelling: a hard line
decisions.reason: The end of the verse is very hard. The word for "their form" is read in place of a written form meaning "their rock", and the last words read literally "from a lofty dwelling for it", that is, without a home, or far from their fine houses. The general sense is that their bodies waste away in Sheol.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place where the dead go, pictured as below the earth (6:6).

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says what Sheol is.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" (Literal); "le séjour des morts" (Balanced, Readable), for this block of psalms
alternatives: "le Shéol" at Balanced, as the English Balanced keeps "Sheol"
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable use the usual French phrase for it, as this translation does throughout. "L'enfer" would add the idea of punishment.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" for Sheol at every level; Readable adds "mahali pa wafu" (the place of the dead) the first time
decisions.reason: "Kuzimu" is the Swahili word for the world of the dead, set for Sheol in the Pentateuch and in Psalms; Readable explains it once here, as the English Readable says "the place of the dead".

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol, the Hebrew name for the place of the dead, is kept as "el Seol" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say what it is, "el lugar de los muertos", the forms settled for these books. "Infierno" would bring in a later idea of punishment.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R), as Psalm 139:8
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (see the meaning decision). The forms follow the published Psalm 139:8; Readable later says "mồ" (grave) where the English Readable says grave.

decisions.choice: "스올" (Sheol) at Literal and Balanced; Readable "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (the place of the dead)
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 139:8 and the terms note: the name is kept, as the English keeps "Sheol"; "지옥" (hell) would say a place of punishment. This holds through these psalms.

decisions.choice: Literal "칠 것이요" (will shepherd, tend), the verb of a shepherd
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb, which pictures death tending them as a flock (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Sheol as "ሲኦል" (Literal), "የሙታን ዓለም" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: In Amharic "ሲኦል" is now heard as hell, the place of punishment; the meaning decision describes the place of all the dead, which Balanced and Readable say plainly, as the terms list settles.

decisions.choice: शिओल (L); अधोलोक (B); मृत्यु का लोक (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol, the place of the dead, is शिओल at Literal, अधोलोक at Balanced and मृत्यु का लोक at Readable, as in 2 Samuel 22; नरक is not used, since it means a place of punishment.

decisions.choice: उनका रूप ... गल जाने [के लिए है] (L); उनके शरीर ... गल जाएँगे (B, R)
decisions.reason: The end of the verse is hard Hebrew (see the meaning decision). Hindi follows the English reading at each level: their form or body wastes away in Sheol, far from their grand dwellings.

decisions.choice: "шеол" (L); "мир мёртвых" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's forms for Sheol, the place of the dead (m4), as in 2 Samuel 22; Readable says "мир мёртвых" where the English says "the place of the dead".

decisions.choice: She'ol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R, also where the English R says "grave"); the last line "それには高い住まいもない" (L), "壮大な住まいから遠く離れる" (B)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's Sheol forms (PSA-1, m4); the last line is hard (m3, uncertain, footnoted) and follows the English reading at each level.

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께서 내 영혼을 스올의 손에서 속량하실 것이니, 그분께서 나를 데려가실 것이기 때문이다. 셀라.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서 값을 치르시고 내 생명을 스올의 손아귀에서 건져 내실 것이니, 그분께서 나를 데려가실 것이다. 셀라.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서 값을 치르시고 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에서 내 목숨을 구해 주실 것이다. 그분께서 나를 데려가 그분과 함께 있게 하실 것이다. 셀라.

pt.L: Mas Deus resgatará a minha alma da mão do Sheol, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me tomará. Selá

hi.B: परंतु परमेश्वर मेरे प्राण का दाम चुकाकर उसे अधोलोक की पकड़ से छुड़ा लेंगे, \q क्योंकि वे मुझे ले लेंगे। सेला

ru.B: Но Бог заплатит выкуп за мою жизнь и освободит её из власти мира мёртвых, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} возьмёт меня. Села
ru.R: Но Бог заплатит цену, чтобы спасти мою жизнь от мира мёртвых. \q Он возьмёт меня к себе. Села

ja.B: しかし神は、わたしの命の代価を払い、陰府の力から解き放ってくださる。 \q その方が、わたしを迎え取ってくださるからだ。セラ

uk.L: Але Бог викупить мою душу з руки шеолу, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} візьме мене. Села
uk.B: Але Бог заплатить викуп за моє життя й вирве його з хватки світу мертвих, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} візьме мене. Села
uk.R: Але Бог заплатить ціну, щоб урятувати моє життя від світу мертвих. \q Він візьме мене, щоб я був із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. Села

decisions.choice: God will ransom my soul: what no one else can do
decisions.reason: No human can pay the ransom for a life (verses 8-9), but God can, and will. This is the answer to the riddle of verse 6.

decisions.choice: he will take me: as God took Enoch and Elijah
decisions.reason: The verb (laqach) is the one used when God took Enoch (Genesis 5:24) and Elijah (2 Kings 2:3, 5). The psalmist hopes that death will not have the last word over him (compare 73:24). How much he saw of life after death is not spelled out.

decisions.choice: the hand of Sheol: the power of death
decisions.reason: The hand is power; Sheol holds the dead in its grip.

decisions.choice: to be with him
decisions.reason: Readable says what "take me" means (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans, as in English
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters; God is set apart by honorific forms (लेंगे, वे) in the third person, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans in this psalm.

decisions.choice: "к себе" without a span
decisions.reason: The English Readable has "him" under the setting; Russian says "к себе", a reflexive, which takes none.

decisions.choice: yiqqacheni "わたしを迎え取ってくださる" (L, B), "わたしを迎えて、ご自分と共にいさせてくださる" (R); padah "贖われる" (L), "代価を払い" (B, R)
decisions.reason: What no one else can do (m1), with the word of 49:8; "take" as God took Enoch and Elijah (m2, uncertain), worded with くださる so it does not read as a passive.

en.L: Do not fear when {{gender:someone|a man}} becomes rich, when the glory of {{gender:their|his}} house increases,
en.B: Do not be alarmed when someone gets rich and their household gains in wealth and honor,
en.R: Do not be upset when someone gets rich and their family becomes more and more important.

fr.L: Ne crains pas quand quelqu’un s’enrichit, quand la gloire de sa maison s’accroît,

sw.B: Usishtuke mtu anapotajirika na jamaa yake ikiongezeka kwa mali na heshima,
